I  am working on Tax Calculator program, want you to help me complete the following functions for tax calculation -

calculate_deductions() -
There are sub limits. investments_80c has max limit of 1.5 lakhs, means if anyone invests 2 lakhs also , we should consider maximum 1.5 lakh, if investment amount below 1.5 lakh then consider that.
Sub limit on Health insurance up to 75000.
There is a deduction called HRA exemption. If rent_paid>0 and hra_received>0, it is calculated minimum of hra_received and 50% of basic salary and Rent Paid - 10% of Basic Salary.
Total deduction is calculated as sum of 80c investment, health insurance, HRA exemption and other_deductions.
The function should return total deduction.

- calculate_tax() should calculate tax , there are two types of regime. By default the regime should be "old". The other regime is called "new".
Tax limit on income for old regime is - # Up to 2.5L - 0%, next # 2.5L to 5L - 5%, next # 5L to 10L - 20% and # 10L+ - 30%.
Tax limit on income for new regime is - Upto is 250000 is 0%, for next 2.5L (i.e till 5lakh ) is 5%, for next 2.5 lakh is 10%, for next 2.5lakh is 15%, for next 2.5L is 20%, for next 2.5lakh is 25% and above any income is 30%.
But if someone choose old tax regime he can avail deduction, in that case first taxable income ( on which tax is applied ) is calculated (income - deduction) and we apply tax on taxable income then. For new regime there is no deduction applicable.
Once tax is calculated based on tax slab, regime then we apply 4% cess on the tax amount. After which it becomes total tax for both the regime.
At the end the function returns [totalTax, cess, taxableIncome] as an array. 
- If income or deduction is less than 0 it must raise an Error. 
- If regime is other than "new" or "old" it should raise Error. 


Total tax and cess should be rounded to 2 decimal point. Could you please help me to write the code for the same?
